# Vendored third-party files

These files are copies of third-party JavaScript and CSS libraries, so that the tool does not load
code from CDNs. The files are taken unmodified from the npm packages; the URLs below serve the same
bytes. To update a library, replace the file and update its version and SHA-256 here.
